entry: User chose ideal observation at adjusted signal close D0; exit permitted from D1.
scope: Current merged leader mainboard pool; user keep-tag (no down gaps and no unfilled gaps at signal). Retrospective membership and prior outcome review create selection bias.
development_boundary: No quote after 2024-12-31; no imported future extreme labels; not blind.
horizon: D1..D60 official exchange sessions; require D60 <= 2024-12-31. Report boundary-purged events separately.
entry_and_exit: Adjusted price-path study only, no shares/corporate-action cash ledger, no fees/slippage or portfolio account; not certified executable PnL.
profit_methods: none: initial stop and D60 time exit
profit70: after prior high >= entry*1.10, lock entry+0.70*(prior_high-entry)
atr25: after prior high >= entry*1.10, trail prior_high-2.5*ATR14_previous
ma5: after prior high >= entry*1.10, close below MA5 -> next eligible session open
ma10: after prior high >= entry*1.10, close below MA10 -> next eligible session open
trailing: Standing stop fixed before each day; high/ATR through previous session only; stop never lowered. Never use same-day high to sell earlier that day.
gap_stop: If day opens below pre-known stop, estimate at open, not stop. One-price down-limit day cannot exit. At down-limit open that unlocks intraday, conservatively estimate lower-limit fill; daily proxy, no queue proof.
limits: Historical mainboard normal10%, isST5% through 2024; raw preclose with cent HALF_UP rounding. Signal patterns require enough history beyond IPO exemptions. Treat all one-price-down days as blocked conservatively.
unavailable: Unknown/malformed quote in any D1..D60 path excluded from comparable metrics and counted. Explicit tradestatus0 halt retained as known nontrading; no invented fills. Open exit pending until active nonblocked quote.
end: If D60 close cannot exit, report unresolved and mark at latest valid close separately, never pretend completed sale.
stop_priority: Known stop takes precedence over end-of-day profit/MA decisions; no profit sell limit. MA signals determined after close and executed next session.
diagnostics: mean adjusted exit price return on comparable paths
70% capture rate for all positive eventual peaks and separately peak>=10%
median per-signal capture ratio for peak>=10%
capture: For positive fixed-window future max gain M, capture=exit_return/M; success exit_return>=0.7*M. M is diagnostics only, never an exit input.
cohorts: 2024 descriptive temporal check; prior summaries seen, not pristine holdout
